answer: PIA's MCR was £35m at 31 December 2025 (S.28.01.01: £34,684k) versus £72m at 31 December 2024. In both years the MCR floor (25% of SCR; SCR £139m in 2025, £288m in 2024) set the MCR. The linear MCR (£17m 2025; £16m 2024) was below the floor, and the cap (45% of SCR: £62m; £130m) and the absolute floor (£4m; £3m) did not bind. The report states 'The MCR is currently 25% of SCR.' The eligible own funds covering the MCR (£430m; £429,645k) are all Tier 1 unrestricted: ordinary share capital, the reconciliation reserve and a capital contribution approved by the Central Bank. There are no Tier 2/3 or ancillary own funds. The ratio of eligible own funds to MCR was 1238.73% at 31 December 2025.
